geometry.evidence: The complete unique Sevii Celio Network Machine is explicitly reviewed in OneIslandPokeCenter as a single96x96 maximum-envelope device, including its whole screen, closed housing, keyboard, vents, status lamps, side consoles and lower-left foot. Crystal has no complete native counterpart to this regional network device. Every original device pixel coordinate, outline, functional cue, alpha and priority remains intact in a documented four-color derivative using the original Crystal clinic hardware blue palette. Only literal per-plane masks of the independently reviewed warm floor/background pixels are replaced by the already selected native Crystal pink diamond clinic floor; the two top corners instead reveal the actual native clinic horizontal wall. Source colors alone never remove a blue/gray hardware pixel, green lamp, yellow status lamp, keyboard key or white device border. Complete source/layer/animation-manifest guards are frozen; original layouts, collision, NPCs, scripts, warps and source actor anchors remain unchanged.
